what: `sed -i` behaves differently on macOS (BSD needs `-i ''`, cannot put a newline in a replacement) and GNU tools from nix sit first on PATH for some commands (`df -g` failed), so every in-place edit became a Python heredoc.
workaround: edit files with the Edit tool or `python3 -I`; never `sed -i`
